title: Decide whether the refused-binding breaker should fall back to the next bindable held claim
outcome: From tm-winf round-10 review (Claude, Low). When Engram refuses the focused claim's binding as stale, the breaker binds without work (up to 5 minutes at a time) even if the session holds another bindable claim; with the omitted>0 keep-current rule in select_engram_held_binding this costs at least one turn without evidence. It self-heals once bound to none. Option: pass the refused binding to select_engram_held_binding as an exclusion so the next candidate is chosen. Caution: binding to a claim the agent is not focused on attributes the turn's evidence to that work item, which is why no-work is the conservative default. At minimum add a test pinning the no-work fallback when another claim has a binding.
